# Remove Audio from Video

- Route: `/tools/remove-audio-from-video`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `video`
- Slug: `remove-audio-from-video`

## Summary

Mute a video for good — strip the audio track and download a silent, video-only file. (Video tools)

## Details

Removing the audio from a video gives you a silent, video-only file — handy for muting background noise, dropping copyrighted music before re-uploading, or preparing a clip you will add new audio to. Media Manipulator strips the audio track and returns the video, stream-copying the picture where possible so there is no quality loss.
### What it does
- Removes (mutes) the audio track and returns a video-only file.
- Stream-copies the video stream where possible — no re-encode, no quality loss.
- Falls back to a re-encode when the container/codec requires it.
- Outputs MP4 by default (WebM also available).
### How to use it
1. Upload your video: The clip whose sound you want gone.
2. Pick the output format: MP4 (default) or WebM.
3. Remove audio: FFmpeg drops the audio and keeps the video.
4. Download: Save the silent, video-only file.
### Supported formats
- Input: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, avi, m4v
- Output: mp4, webm
- Video is stream-copied where possible; the audio track is removed entirely. Download suffix: _silent.
### Technical details
- We stream-copy the video stream (`-c:v copy -an`) so the picture is untouched; if the container does not accept the source codec we re-encode to H.264.
- The output has no audio track at all — it is silent, not just muted to zero volume.
- The downloaded filename is suffixed `_silent` so you can tell it apart from the original.
### Use cases
- Mute background noise: Remove unwanted sound from a clip.
- Drop copyrighted audio: Strip music before re-posting.
- Prep for new audio: Get a silent base to add a voiceover to.
- Privacy: Remove a conversation captured in the background.
### FAQ
Q: How do I remove audio from a video?
A: Upload the video, pick an output format, and download the silent, video-only file.
Q: Does this mute the video or remove the track?
A: It removes the audio track entirely, so the result is truly silent rather than muted to zero.
Q: Will the video quality change?
A: No — we stream-copy the video stream where possible, so the picture is untouched.
Q: Why is the file named "_silent"?
A: We add a _silent suffix so you can tell the audio-free copy apart from the original.

## Routing

When to send a visitor here: Send visitors here when they want a silent copy of a video: "mute this clip", "strip the sound", "remove the audio track". The video is stream-copied where possible.
When to send them elsewhere: If they want the audio track out of the video as a file ("rip the audio", "get the sound"), that is the opposite: use Extract Audio from Video (extract-audio-from-video). To swap the soundtrack for music or a voiceover, use Add Audio to Video (stitch-audio-to-video) in replace mode.
Related tools: extract-video-only-from-video (removes every audio stream); extract-audio-from-video (keep the sound instead); stitch-audio-to-video (add a new soundtrack); compress-video (shrink the silent file)
